```javascript
const gameState = {
  day:1, timeOfDay:6*60, dayLength:24*60, daySpeed:2.5,
  _noonProductsDespawned:false, _wiltChecked:false,
  isNight:false, zone:'Farm',
  camera:{x:0,y:0}, season:'Dry Summer', particles:[],
  stormActive:false, stormSheltering:false,
  _postEnding: false,
  _stormIntensity:0,      // 0.0–1.0 current visual/gameplay intensity
  _stormPhase:'none',     // 'none' | 'warning' | 'building' | 'peak' | 'fading'
  _stormTimer:0,          // seconds elapsed in current phase
  _stormPhaseDur:0,       // total seconds for current phase
  _stormWarnShown:false,  // warning message fired this storm
  _shelterTX:0, _shelterTY:0, // tile pos where manual shelter was chosen
  inMine:false, mineFloor:0, _deepestMineFloor:0,
  inBLMine:false, blMineFloor:0, // The Company Mine in the badlands
  _mineDread:0,            // 0–100 dread meter for dark floors
  _mineJournal:[],         // [{day, text, isSurveyor}] persistent mine log
  _mineLastHaul:{},        // {oreId:{flawed,standard,pure}} from last session
  _deepMapUsed:{},         // {floorKey:day} tracks deep-map one-use-per-floor-per-day
  _mineCoalSessions:0,     // tracks consecutive coal-mining sessions for blue coal unlock
  _activeBranch:null,      // current pending branch choice {node,key,fl,baseQty,lootId}
  _candleBurnLeft:0,       // seconds remaining on active beeswax candle
  _torchBurnLeft:90,       // seconds remaining on current torch (resets per torch)
  inBadlands:false,
  inHoboCamp:false,
  inOcean:false,
  boatX: 24*32, boatY: 38*32,
  boatVX:0, boatVY:0,
  pirateHeat: 0,   // 0-5: escalates with pirate kills, resets each night
};

const player = {
  x:17*T+T/2, y:26*T+T/2,
  speed:112, sprintMult:1.75,
  hp:100, maxHp:100,
  stamina:100, maxStamina:100, staminaRegen:14, _baseMaxStamina:100,
  gold:120,
  debt:0,
  w:18, h:18,
  sprinting:false,
  facing:'down', walkFrame:0, walkTimer:0,
  tool:'till', selectedSeed:'carrot',
  actionCooldown:0,
  attackCooldown:0,
  invincibleTimer:0,
  attackFlash:0,
  _harvestCooldownTimer:0,
  _harvestCooldownMax:0,
  _rodTier:0,           // 0=bamboo 1=cane 2=copper 3=iron 4=gold
  _quickCookRecipe:null,
  // ── Character customization ──
  name:'Stranger',
  gender:'male',
  skinTone:0,
  hairStyle:0,
  hairColor:0,
  shirtStyle:0,
  shirtColor:0,
  pantsColor:0,
  hatColor:0,
};

const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');

let ZOOM = BASE_ZOOM * Math.min(window.innerWidth / BASE_W, window.innerHeight / BASE_H);

const T = 32;

let BASE_ZOOM = (('ontouchstart' in window) || navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0) ? 0.85 : 3.25;

const BASE_W = 1280;

const BASE_H = 720;

function centerCameraOnPlayer() {
  gameState.camera.x = player.x - (canvas.width  / ZOOM) / 2;
  gameState.camera.y = player.y - (canvas.height / ZOOM) / 2;
}
```
